purpose: Human 판단과 Machine-derived 상태를 한 문서에서 구분하고 Generated View의 stale 상태를 검출한다.

review_policy.HUMAN_AUTHORITATIVE: Human owns value; Agent may propose but cannot confirm.
review_policy.HUMAN_REVIEWED: Agent drafts; responsible reviewer accepts or changes.
review_policy.SHARED: Machine evidence plus accountable human review.
review_policy.MACHINE_DERIVED: Regenerated from current evidence; human may flag but should not overwrite source fact.
review_policy.GENERATED_VIEW: Projection only; regenerate from Canonical/Internal source.
